blocks.text: Employment Counsel must approve an involuntary termination before the off-boarding case is opened.
After approval, HR conducts the termination meeting while IT disables SSO and VPN access in parallel. Preserve the case record and approval in the HR case file.
If Legal places a litigation hold, do not wipe the laptop; transfer it to Legal custody instead.

messages.text: Correction to the old checklist: Security, not the manager, now disables privileged access at the same time as IT disables SSO.
I hope the meeting room has good coffee today.
Remember to badge in through the north entrance while the lobby is being renovated.
HR is hosting a lunch-and-learn on the benefits portal next week — RSVP if you want to attend.
